snippet.title: CNCF [Cloud Native Computing Foundation]
snippet.description: To provide educational and informative content on cloud native computing, which uses an open source software stack to deploy applications as microservices, packaging each part into its own container, and dynamically orchestrating those containers to optimize resource utilization. Educational content on CNCF projects, like Kubernetes and Prometheus, will also be provided.
